data.name: Sabariyah
data.gender_notes: Sabariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sabariyah is a beautiful name that symbolizes the virtues of patience and perseverance. It is derived from the Arabic word 'sabr' which means to bear with equanimity. The name Sabariyah carries the meaning “Patience and perseverance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Sabariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody patience and perseverance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Quran 2:155, 'And indeed, with hardship comes ease'
data.etymology: Sabariyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Patience and perseverance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabariyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: سبارية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الصبر والسلوان في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سبارية هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ويعني الصبر والسلوان. وقد وردت مشتقاته في القرآن الكريم، مثل سورة البقرة آية 286، حيث يقول الله تعالى: 'وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمُ يُوقِنُونَ'، وفي آية أخرى: 'وَلَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ'. وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية كرمز للصبر والسلوان.

in_urdu.name: سباریہ
in_urdu.meaning: سباریہ نام کا مطلب ہے صبر اور تسلی
in_urdu.long_meaning: سباریہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے صبر اور تسلی۔ اس نام کی اصیل عربی جڑیں ہیں اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا استعمال ایک علامت کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے جو صبر اور تسلی کی خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں، یہ نام روایتی اور روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सबारीयाह
in_hindi.meaning: सबारीयाह नाम का अर्थ है धैर्य और सांत्वना
in_hindi.long_meaning: सबारीयाह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है धैर्य और सांत्वना। इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक पारंपरिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व के रूप में किया जाता है, जो धैर्य और आत्म-संयम की विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: سباريه
in_pashto.meaning: سباريه د صبر او تسلي نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: سباريه يو مونث نوم دى چه د اربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوى دى. دغه نوم د صبر او تسلي معنی لري. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د يوې ښځې لپاره کارول کىږي چه د صبر او تسلي ځانګړتى ولري.

in_english.name: Sabariyah
in_english.meaning: The name Sabariyah means patience and solace
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sabariyah originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'sabr' which means patience. In Islamic tradition, Sabariyah symbolizes the virtues of patience and solace. The name has been mentioned in various forms throughout history and is used across Muslim cultures to signify a person who embodies these qualities. Etymologically, it is derived from the Arabic root 'S-B-R' which is also mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing the importance of patience in faith.

data.cultural_impact: Sabariyah holds a rich cultural legacy in the Islamic world as it is reminiscent of the patience of the Islamic saint, Sabari. Sabari was a poor, old woman who lived during the time of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) in Yemen. She was well-known for her deep love and devotion to God. She would spend her days in worship and her nights in prayer. One day, the Prophet (PBUH) was on a military expedition and passed by her cave. Sabari came out to greet him, bringing him food and water. The Prophet (PBUH) was touched by her devotion and blessed her, predicting that she would attain a high place in Paradise. The name Sabariyah evokes the spirit of Sabari, inspiring people to be patient, persevering, and loving towards God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sabariyah holds deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is a reminder of the important virtue of Sabr (patience) that is essential for a meaningful spiritual journey. The name nudges us to recognize that hardships and obstacles are part of life, and that the true measure of our faith lies in how we respond to them. The name Sabariyah calls us to be steadfast in our faith, to persevere in our worship and to remain steadfast in times of trouble and hardship. It also invites us to develop a deep inner peace, the serenity that comes from knowing that God is with us in every moment. In this way, the name Sabariyah inspires us to cultivate a deeper, more meaningful relationship with God.
